**Group:** Diatoms  ·  **Optics:** low-mag

## Defining characteristics

A low-magnification morphotype class for a chain-forming diatom with a distinct helical or coiling shape. Cells possibly beloning to __Eucampia__ or __Asterionellopsis__. Key features: Long diatom chain with a helical or coiling shape.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **diatom_chain_1** | Morphotypes 1 has large thick setae. |
| **diatom_chain_3** | Morphotypes 3 diatom chains are straight and large, thick setae are absent. |
